//: Type-checks hooks/lcm-hooks.ts, the function-hooks module, which the main tsconfig does not cover: it compiles against `claude-code`, a module that exists only as declarations Claude Code writes from the running build into .claude-plugin/types/ when it loads this checkout as a plugin (`claude --plugin-dir .`). Those declarations are early access and deliberately not committed — a stale copy would compile against an API that no longer exists. So this runs on demand (npm run typecheck:hooks), never in CI. Settings come verbatim from the header of the generated declarations: no DOM in `lib` (the environment has none, and the DOM's own Text would shadow the element), and `types: []` because the module has no Node.
